description: Comprehensive modernization of the matter-js 2D physics engine codebase. This is a breaking major version that transforms the legacy ES5 codebase into idiomatic modern JavaScript with ES modules, ES6 classes, modern syntax, TypeScript type definitions, ESM-only build output via Rollup, and Vitest as the test runner. All breaking changes must be documented in a changelog. Phase 1 (var→const/let, polyfill removal, tooling upgrade) is already complete.

userStories.title: Modern JavaScript Syntax
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want the codebase to use modern JavaScript syntax so that the code is more readable, concise, and idiomatic.
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow functions used for all anonymous callbacks and short functions (preserving `this`-dependent functions as regular functions where needed)
Template literals replace string concatenation
Destructuring used for object/array unpacking where it improves clarity
`for...of` loops replace index-based `for` loops where iterating values (keep index loops for performance-critical collision/physics code)
Optional chaining (`?.`) and nullish coalescing (`??`) used where appropriate
Shorthand property/method syntax used in object literals
Default parameters replace manual `typeof` / `||` defaults
Spread syntax replaces `Array.prototype.slice.call` and manual array copying
All 31 source files updated
Build succeeds and all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Convert to ES Modules
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the codebase to use ES module `import`/`export` syntax so that it works natively with modern bundlers and runtimes without wrapper patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Each source file uses `import` / `export` instead of the current `module.exports` / `require` or global assignment pattern
Circular dependency chains identified and resolved or documented
`src/module/main.js` becomes the package entry point with named exports for all public modules
Internal cross-module references use direct imports instead of `Matter.ModuleName` lookup
The `Matter` namespace object is still available as a default export for convenience
Build succeeds and all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Convert to ES6 Classes
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want physics objects (Body, Composite, Constraint, etc.) to use ES6 class syntax so that the code structure is clear and extensible.
acceptanceCriteria: `Body`, `Composite`, `Constraint`, `MouseConstraint` converted from factory/object pattern to classes with constructors
`Engine`, `Runner`, `Render`, `Mouse` converted to classes

Static utility modules (`Vector`, `Vertices`, `Bounds`, `Axes`, `SAT`, `Collision`, `Resolver`, `Detector`, `Query`, `Pairs`, `Pair`, `Contact`, `Sleeping`, `Events`, `Common`, `Plugin`) converted to classes with static methods or remain as plain module exports (whichever is more appropriate per module)
Factory modules (`Bodies`, `Composites`) converted appropriately
`Body.create(options)` pattern replaced with `new Body(options)` constructor
Default property values set in constructors instead of `create` functions
Private/internal properties identified and prefixed with `_` or use `#` private fields
`World` deprecated module handled (it extends `Composite`) - either merged or clearly re-exported
Build succeeds and all existing tests pass

userStories.title: ESM-Only Rollup Build
userStories.description: As a consumer, I want matter-js distributed as an ES module built with Rollup so that I can use tree-shaking and native module loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Rollup config updated to output ESM format only (remove UMD)
`package.json` updated: `"type": "module"`, `"exports"` field with ESM entry
Remove `"main"` field or point it to ESM bundle
`build/matter.js` is an ES module bundle
Minified bundle `build/matter.min.js` also ESM
Source maps generated for both bundles
Named exports available for tree-shaking (`import { Body, Engine } from 'matter-js'`)
Default export available for compatibility (`import Matter from 'matter-js'`)
Build succeeds and all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Migrate Test Suite to Vitest
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want the test suite to use Vitest so that tests run fast, support ES modules natively, and provide a modern developer experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Vitest installed and configured (`vitest.config.js` or config in `vite.config.js`)
Existing test files migrated from current test runner to Vitest syntax (`describe`, `it`, `expect`)
Test files use ES module `import` syntax
All existing physics simulation tests pass with identical results
`npm test` runs Vitest
`npm run test:watch` available for development
CI workflow updated to run Vitest on Node 20 and 22
Lint and format checks pass in CI
Old test runner dependencies removed from `package.json`

userStories.title: TypeScript Type Definitions
userStories.description: As a TypeScript user, I want accurate type definitions so that I get autocomplete and type checking when using matter-js.
acceptanceCriteria: JSDoc type annotations added to all public API functions, methods, and properties
A generated `.d.ts` file produced from JSDoc (or hand-written `.d.ts` if generation is insufficient)
`package.json` includes `"types"` field pointing to the type definitions

Types cover: Body, Composite, Constraint, Engine, Runner, Render, Mouse, MouseConstraint, Events, Vector, Vertices, Bounds, Bodies, Composites, Query, Common, Plugin, Detector, Collision, Pair, Pairs, SAT, Sleeping
Generic event types for `Events.on` / `Events.off` / `Events.trigger`
Options/config objects have typed interfaces
Types validate against a basic TypeScript consumer test file

userStories.title: Clean Up Deprecated APIs and Dead Code
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want all deprecated code paths, compatibility shims, and dead code removed so that the codebase is lean and maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: `World.js` either removed (merged into Composite) or clearly marked as a thin re-export with no duplicate logic
Any remaining `Common.warn` deprecation messages for removed features cleaned up
`Svg.js` dependency on external `SVGPathSeg` polyfill documented or replaced
Unused internal helper functions in `Common.js` identified and removed
No `arguments` object usage remains (replaced by rest parameters in US-001)
All `@deprecated` JSDoc tags correspond to actually deprecated items, not already-removed ones

userStories.title: Breaking Changes Changelog
userStories.description: As a user upgrading matter-js, I want a detailed changelog documenting all breaking changes so that I can migrate my code confidently.
acceptanceCriteria: `CHANGELOG.md` created or updated with a new major version section
Every breaking change categorized: API removals, API renames, behavioral changes, build output changes
Migration guide for each breaking change (before → after code examples)

Documents: removal of `Grid.js`, removal of polyfill helpers (`Common.keys`, `Common.values`, `Common.isArray`, `Common.isString`), removal of `World` (if applicable), `Body.create()` → `new Body()`, UMD → ESM output, Node 18+ requirement, `var` → `const`/`let` (for anyone extending internals)
Documents removal of back-compat properties (`render.controller`, `engine.grid`, `engine.broadphase`, `engine.metrics`)
New minimum Node.js version documented
New import syntax documented

userStories.title: Update Examples and Demo
userStories.description: As a user exploring matter-js, I want examples and the demo app to work with the modernized API so that I can learn from up-to-date code.
acceptanceCriteria: Example files updated to use `import` and `new Body()` class constructor syntax
Demo app updated to work with ESM build
`demo/` build/serve scripts work correctly
At least one example verified to run correctly in a browser
